findings.finding: Heap buffer overflow reading a 15-character author chain ID from a valid three-atom CIF. Gemmi independently reads all atoms and the full chain identifier.
findings.cause: getNextWord writes into parser->chain_auth allocated as numberAtoms * CHAIN_SIZE (CHAIN_SIZE=4), without respecting the destination allocation.
findings.intel_scope: Original Intel non-instrumented probe returns successfully; that does not establish its memory safety. This overflow is confirmed in the pinned ARM source build, not proven architecture-exclusive.

findings.finding: ABI18 path truncates label chain IDs to two characters; AAA, AAB, AAC collide as AA. Intel ABI20 reader preserves tested label identifiers.
Real DDE pocket run accepts invalid and non-finite PDB coordinate fields and emits success artifacts.
Both readers accept truncated topology content or out-of-range bonds; malformed parm7 missing FORMAT hangs until the 30-second timeout kills it.
Space, quote, and semicolon filenames fail; .ent, .mmcif, and uppercase .PDB pass DDE extension validation but fail in fpocket.
Quoted CIF atom names retain quote characters; missing CIF coordinates are converted into numeric output. These also occur with the original Intel reader.

Eight unchanged DDE tests fail: one bootstrap environment assumption, one installer text assertion, two normalization contract expectations, one PubChem slug expectation, and three obsolete Click mix_stderr test calls.

harness_notes: Initial unittest discovery lacked pytest and mixed modules with global stubs; final count is isolated pytest modules, not that unsuccessful attempt.

Test-only pytest dependencies were installed outside the DDE venv; per-container SELinux labels required a separate network-disabled diagnostic container with label isolation disabled only for that container.

The initial same-project workflow expected automatic analysis replacement. DDE correctly refused; a separate test confirmed preservation and successful explicit alternate output. This is protective behaviour, not a product defect.
Non-finite reader values cause the existing probe to throw intentionally; its abort is not evidence of a library-originated crash.
Bundled 1UYD_wrote.cif is rejected by both ARM and Intel for bad element indices; remaining 19 bundled CIF reader checks pass.
Comment-decorated AMBER topology is rejected by both readers; format-support limitation recorded without claiming standards conformance.
provisioning_change: Reject a release when REVOKED.json exists
